The bowl is a stainless steel mixing bowl, probably 24-28 cm across at the rim. The chicken pieces sit in a cluster about 10 cm wide, mostly one layer deep, and look like cooked diced chicken breast.

Each piece is roughly 1.5-2 cm across and about 1 cm thick, so it weighs around 3-4 g. I count about 55 pieces. That gives roughly 150-180 g, though some pieces are thin, so I'll use about 140 g.

Cooked chicken breast runs about 165 kcal per 100 g. At 140 g that is about 230 kcal. There is little visible oil, so I'm not adding any.
